h1: Specialist unvented-cylinder support, led by Yassi
title: About G3 Qualified Engineer London | Unvented Specialists
description: Meet the G3 Qualified Engineer London service and its diagnosis-led approach to Megaflo, unvented cylinders and practical hot-water support.
answer: The business focuses on unvented cylinders, Megaflo systems and diagnosis-led hot-water support for London homes and managed properties.

sections.heading: A focused service
paragraphs: An unvented cylinder is a pressurised hot-water storage appliance with several safety layers. Choosing the correct person for the work matters as much as choosing a replacement component. Our service is built around the cylinder, expansion arrangement, pressure controls, discharge path and the system that heats the stored water.

sections.heading: Yassi and the service approach
paragraphs: The existing website names Yassi as the lead engineer. The specialist focus is inspection, servicing and diagnosis of unvented-cylinder faults. We explain findings and discuss the proposed scope before agreed work begins.

Specific training records, certificate numbers, insurance details and manufacturer approvals should be checked when choosing an engineer. We do not use product branding as a substitute for those checks.

sections.heading: Advice that distinguishes systems
paragraphs: Megaflo is a cylinder brand, Heatrae Sadia manufactures several different types of heating and water-heating products, and G3 relates to hot-water system safety. A qualification for unvented cylinders does not on its own establish permission to carry out gas work, complex electrical work or heat-pump refrigerant work.
The knowledge library separates those subjects and identifies where manufacturer instructions or additional competence are needed.

faqs.question: Does working on Megaflo mean the business is Heatrae Sadia itself?
faqs.answer: No. This is an independent engineering service; manufacturer names identify equipment and do not establish an official manufacturer affiliation.
